# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
combp_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp")
smoking_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp_smoking")
region_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp_region")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
```

# Define Functions

```{r func}
get_significant_dmrs <- function() {
  read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_DMRs.csv")) %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      cols = "DMR", delim = ":", names = c("chrom", "pos")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      cols = "pos", delim = "-", names = c("start", "end")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select("chrom", "start", "end") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      start = as.integer(.data$start),
      end = as.integer(.data$end)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$chrom, .data$start)
}

get_region_commands <- function() {
  c(
    "#!/bin/bash",
    "",
    "set -euo pipefail",
    "",
    paste0(
      "comb-p region_p",
      " -p combp_input.bed",
      " -r interact_dmrs.bed",
      " -s 50",
      " -c 5",
      " > interact_dmrs_retested.bed"
    )
  )
}

# input_dir holds the 02c comb-p input for this analysis
prepare_region_run <- function(label, input_dir, dmr_df) {
  out_dir <- file.path(region_dir, label)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # same per-CpG input as the 02c discovery run (column 5 = interaction P)
  stopifnot(file.copy(
    file.path(input_dir, "combp_input.bed"),
    file.path(out_dir, "combp_input.bed"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  ))

  write.table(
    dmr_df,
    file = file.path(out_dir, "interact_dmrs.bed"),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = c("#chrom", "start", "end")
  )

  writeLines(get_region_commands(), file.path(out_dir, "combp_commands.sh"))
}
```

# Create Inputs and Commands

```{r run}
dmr_df <- get_significant_dmrs()
cat("Significant DMRs to retest:", nrow(dmr_df), "\n")

prepare_region_run("Primary", combp_dir, dmr_df)
prepare_region_run("Smoking_Adjusted", smoking_dir, dmr_df)
```
